Latest WhatsApp TestFlight 版本嘅參考資料顯示，Meta 正為 iPhone 用戶研發 iCloud 備份嘅替代方案。以下係詳情。

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to a discovery by WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users as an alternative to iCloud.

The feature is not yet available to WhatsApp's TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo managed to activate an interface that allows users to choose between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service for backups. The interface shows that 2GB of free storage will be provided, and the report indicates that paid plans could go up to 1TB.

The report also mentions that while users can choose whether their WhatsApp backups on iCloud are end-to-end encrypted, WhatsApp's own backup system will be end-to-end encrypted by default.

The following is from WABetaInfo:

Although an official rollout timeline has not been announced, the report notes that WhatsApp is also working on a Google Drive backup alternative for Android users. Given that development is happening simultaneously on both platforms, the feature is likely to be officially announced in the not-too-distant future.
